decision_target: >= +2.0 pp, one-sided case-paired sign-flip p<=0.05, validity drop <= 2 pp
primary_metric: six-family equal-weight strict pass@1 (trained minus base), 48 cases/family x 8 responses; sorption 3 cases descriptive
statistics_method: primary: one-sided case-paired sign-flip test on per-case strict-rate differences (trained minus start) over the confirmatory six families, equal family weights via per-family mean then average; exact enumeration if <=24 nonzero cases else 2,000,000 Monte Carlo flips with seed 20261010; descriptive 95% family-stratified case bootstrap interval (10,000 draws)
